changes.text: Fix demo data seeding so delete protection, auto-hide, and the Show demo data toggle actually work
Fix engagement finding counts to respect the Show demo data setting

Fix a navigation race that could leave stale page content on screen, a blocking dialog that made user creation look frozen, and several smaller UI/copy bugs (evidence image label, vulnerability count pluralization, Archived page header, Changelog page copy)
Fix idle-session warning banner showing raw seconds instead of a readable minutes/seconds countdown
Add an optional email field to user accounts for admin contact/records, plus a documented break-glass password reset for a locked-out master admin (create_admin.py --reset)
Replace the frozen v3.7.0 sidebar badge (left over from a scrapped semver scheme) with the live build commit hash
Remove the sidebar version badge (redundant with the Updates page)

Add signer_title, report_classification, and compliance_framework app settings so the POA&M report signature title, classification banner, and framework reference are configurable instead of hardcoded
Add default_finding_owner and require_due_date_high_risk app settings — configurable default owner for new findings, and an optional block on saving Critical/High risk findings without a due date

Add per-risk due date SLA settings (Critical/High/Medium/Low, defaulting to 15/30/60/90 days) that auto-calculate a finding's due date on creation when none is set, replacing the old default_due_date_days setting

Fix a crash in the /upload-simple PDF import route caused by a column/value mismatch in the finding insert, and bring it in line with the main import path (default owner setting, auto-calculated due date)

Add per-username account lockout: after max_login_attempts (default 3) consecutive failed logins, the account is locked for lockout_duration_minutes (default 5, both configurable by a master admin), with a clear wait-time message and no bypass via a correct password during lockout

Add IP-based login rate limiting: after ip_rate_limit_max_attempts (default 20) failed logins from one IP within a rolling window (default 15 min), that IP is blocked for ip_rate_limit_lockout_minutes (default 15), regardless of username — closing the gap where per-username lockout alone doesn't stop guessing sprayed across many usernames from one source

Security hardening: escape all user-submitted content in the UI to close stored-XSS gaps, validate evidence uploads by actual file content instead of just filename extension, require authentication to view uploaded evidence files, and enforce the read-only auditor role server-side (not just in the UI) for creating/editing findings, engagements, and PDF/CSV imports

Add a single "Enable/Disable Demo Mode" control in Settings, replacing the old demo_data_visible toggle. The first click generates sample findings, engagements, and vulnerability scan/host data (previously required running scripts manually and left the Hosts and activity views empty); later clicks just show/hide it without re-seeding or deleting anything

Seed demo data with vulnerability scan history (2 earlier snapshots plus current) so the Vulnerabilities trend graph shows a real weekly/monthly progress curve instead of "not enough scan history yet"; also spread the two demo pen-test engagements further apart in time and fixed a crash-on-reseed bug in the vuln_scopes insert

Add a Vulnerability Report page for auditors: mean time to patch by severity, completion rate by severity, scan-to-scan velocity, and an aging table of the oldest open findings, alongside the existing progress-over-time trend

Fix auditor/analyst roles getting an error on the POA&M Auditor Reports page (and silently losing branding/idle-timeout settings elsewhere) because it required admin access just to read org name and report labels
Group related settings into labeled cards on the Settings page (Branding, Report Content, Findings & Workflow, Login & Session Security) instead of one long flat list
Vulnerability scan uploads now mark findings as Likely Resolved when they disappear from a rescan of the same scope, instead of leaving them stuck Open.
